params.description: Kubernetes namespace to filter results by. If omitted, returns results from all namespaces.

params.name: kind
params.description: Chaos type kind to filter by, such as PodChaos, NetworkChaos, IOChaos, StressChaos, HTTPChaos, TimeChaos, DNSChaos, or KernelChaos.

params.name: name
params.description: Name substring to filter results by.

params.name: status
params.description: Status to filter experiments or schedules by.

items.docs: Returns a list of chaos experiments across all or a filtered set of namespaces. Results can be filtered by namespace, kind (chaos type), name substring, and status. Each experiment entry includes the chaos type, namespace, name, current status, and creation timestamp.

Creates a new chaos experiment by submitting a Chaos Mesh custom resource to Kubernetes. The request body must include the kind field specifying the chaos type (e.g., PodChaos, NetworkChaos) and a spec field with the chaos-type-specific configuration. The experiment begins immediately upon creation unless a duration or schedule is specified.

params.name: uid
params.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the chaos experiment.

items.docs: Returns detailed information about a specific chaos experiment identified by its UID. The response includes the full experiment specification, current status, affected pods, and event history.

params.name: uid
params.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the chaos experiment.

params.name: force
params.description: When true, force-deletes the experiment without waiting for cleanup.

items.docs: Deletes a chaos experiment and stops the ongoing fault injection. When force is true, the experiment is deleted immediately without waiting for graceful cleanup. The deleted experiment is moved to the archives.

params.name: uid
params.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the chaos experiment.

items.docs: Pauses a running chaos experiment, stopping fault injection without deleting the experiment resource. The experiment can be resumed by calling the start endpoint. Useful for temporarily halting chaos during incident response.

params.name: uid
params.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the chaos experiment.

items.docs: Resumes a paused chaos experiment, reinstating fault injection. Can also be used to start an experiment that was created in a paused state.

items.docs: Returns a list of Chaos Mesh workflows. Workflows allow orchestrating multiple chaos experiments in serial or parallel sequences. Results can be filtered by namespace, name, and status.

Creates a new Chaos Mesh workflow for orchestrating multiple chaos experiments. The workflow spec defines a directed acyclic graph of tasks that can run in serial, parallel, or with suspend steps. Each task can reference a chaos template or be a sub-workflow.

params.name: uid
params.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the workflow.

items.docs: Returns detailed information about a specific workflow including its current execution state, the status of each task node, and associated event history.

params.name: uid
params.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the workflow.

items.docs: Updates an existing workflow definition. The updated spec replaces the existing workflow configuration. Running workflow nodes are not interrupted; changes take effect on future executions.

params.name: uid
params.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the workflow.

items.docs: Deletes a Chaos Mesh workflow and stops any running chaos tasks within it. The deleted workflow is moved to the archives.

items.docs: Returns a list of chaos experiment schedules. Schedules use cron expressions to trigger chaos experiments automatically at configured intervals. Results can be filtered by namespace, name, and status.

Creates a new chaos experiment schedule. The schedule wraps a chaos experiment spec with a cron expression and optional history limits. The chaos experiment is instantiated automatically each time the schedule fires.

params.name: uid
params.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the schedule.

items.docs: Returns detailed information about a specific chaos schedule including its cron expression, embedded chaos spec, and history of triggered experiment instances.

params.name: uid
params.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the schedule.

items.docs: Deletes a chaos experiment schedule. No further experiment instances will be created. Running experiments triggered by the schedule are not affected.

params.name: uid
params.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the schedule.

items.docs: Pauses a chaos schedule so that no new experiment instances are created while the schedule is suspended. Existing running experiments are not affected.

params.name: uid
params.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the schedule.

items.docs: Resumes a paused chaos schedule so that new experiment instances are created again on the configured cron schedule.

Returns the list of Kubernetes namespaces available for targeting chaos experiments. Used to populate namespace selectors in the Chaos Dashboard UI.

info.name: Chaos Mesh List pods for a selector

items.docs: Returns a list of pods matching the given label selectors and namespaces. Used to preview which pods will be affected by a chaos experiment before creating it, so operators can verify their target selector.
